description: The line plot illustrates the performance of four types of code-related resources—Tutorials (blue circles), Library Documentation (red circles), StackOverflow posts (yellow circles), and Github files (green circles)—as measured against the “Number of Tokens” on the x-axis, which ranges from 200 to 1000 in increments of 200, and a y-axis representing an unspecified performance metric ranging from 10 to 40 in increments of 10. The blue line for Tutorials starts at approximately 23 at 200 tokens, rises to about 29 at 500 tokens, peaks at 29.5 at 800 tokens, and then slightly declines to 29 at 1000 tokens. The red line for Library Documentation begins at 26 at 200 tokens, increases to 29.5 at 500 tokens, reaches its peak at 32.5 at 800 tokens, and then drops to 27.5 at 1000 tokens. The yellow line for StackOverflow posts starts highest at 33 at 200 tokens, declines steadily to 30 at 500 tokens, drops sharply to 19 at 800 tokens, and further decreases to 11 at 1000 tokens. The green line for Github files begins at 28 at 200 tokens, rises gradually to 31 at 500 tokens, peaks at 33 at 800 tokens, and then falls slightly to 30 at 1000 tokens. All lines are connected with solid lines and marked with circular data points at each measured token count.
